dialogue: Oh you don't know what a wisp is?
Ok, so you see that starting totem I was standing by?
Well that was left by a snarky Firefly
You see this bozo, flew through this area and recorded how long it took them.
Theres an end point just a little ahead, where we race to
Then whenever you beat their time they give a reward.
But these guys are practically cheating.
Well, maybe not cheating, but they get to fly, and I dont.
But, I know I can still make it through this area, just as fast as them.
So far I've beaten most of the totems, in this forest.
Most of them will give you two rewards. You see, these dorks are kinda arrogant.
They dont really try unless youve beat them once.
So after you beat their first time, theyll start trying for real
Well, ok some of them do make a really solid effort their first time.
But they always are able to go faster the second time.
So right now Im trying to beat this one for the second time, but honestly this ones giving me a hard time.
But I know its possible. I met a [color=#f8c868]Bee[/color] once who said shes beaten ALL of them. So it's definitely possible.
Honestly, its pretty fun, and I like proving that just because I cant fly, doesnt mean I cant beat them.
If you wanna try feel free, there are many scattered around here. I think GG is hiding one somewhere around here, but I'm not sure where.
If you need any tips, feel free to ask, theres a lot of tricks Ive learned to help me beat them.
